arguments.command:
cd /work/tmp && python3 -c "
import random
rng = random.Random(5)
seen = set()
lines = []
while len(lines) < 200001:
    u = rng.getrandbits(48)
    ln = 64
    if (u, ln) in seen: continue
    seen.add((u, ln))
    w = [(u>>32)&0xffff,(u>>16)&0xffff,u&0xffff,0,0,0,0,0]
    lines.append(':'.join('%x'%x for x in w) + '/64 %d\n' % rng.randrange(1<<32))
open('fib_over2.txt','w').writelines(lines)
print('records:', len(lines))
" && /work/submit/planb64 build fib_over2.txt over2.idx; echo "rc=200001-records=$? exists=$(test -e over2.idx && echo yes || echo no)"
